captions.text: A ghost hand teaches the first shape. Copy it, and your shadow wakes.
Then the Lantern tells a story nobody has heard before, improvised live by Claude.
You answer with your hands: the shadow you make is who comes next.
It asked for a bird. Make a fox instead, and the story bends around you.
The stage follows the story: moonrise, wind, rain, lightning, dawn.
Every tale leaves a keepsake on your wall, and a promise for tomorrow.
The next night: the moon has grown, your keepsakes are still there, and the Lantern keeps its promise.
No hands? Look to choose: a gold ring fills, and whoever you look at answers.
Play with a friend: two walls far apart, two lanterns, one story.
Their shadows fall in blue on your wall. Only shadow shapes travel, never camera images.

end.title: Shadowplay
lines: Hands only. Seated. On your own wall.
A new story every night, alone or with a friend.
end.credit: Footage: Meta IWER Quest 3 emulator, scripted hand input. Stories improvised live by Claude; the Lantern's voice is OpenAI text-to-speech.
